note: Cached fallback lines for Cinder. Moods: amused, annoyed, triumphant, menacing. Max 15 words each. Allowed moods per act: see picker_config.json.

lines.text: Mm, there it goes. Doesn't it feel nice to let something go?
Oh, that was fun. Burn another, Keeper. I'll carry it anywhere.
Delivered! Don't thank me. Nobody ever does.
Back and forth, hour to hour. I never get tired. Isn't that useful?
Another hour kept. You're so good at keeping things, Keeper.
Rewinding again? Fine. I'll wait. I'm very good at waiting.
Don't mind me, Keeper. I've got nothing but time. Hours and hours of it.
Still thinking? Some of us have been burning all day.
Oh, look. Company. They remember you, Keeper.
Another one. Every burn leaves something behind, Keeper. Didn't you know?
Ha! ...Ha. Funny. It used to echo further than that.
Go on, burn it. Somebody has to keep this place warm.
Gone? Oh, they don't go. They just wait somewhere you can't see.
Solved it. Again. Ever wonder what each solution cost, Keeper?
I'm not escaping the clock, Keeper. I'm finishing it. Your order built it around me.
Wind it, and I go out. Leave it, and the day does. Choose, Keeper.
Go on, wind it. You were always so good at keeping me.
Delivered, Keeper. Last one. Go on, thank me. Nobody ever has.
Back in time already? Careful, Keeper. Some things only go one way.
Take it back, then. Must be lovely, being able to.
I'm told patience is a virtue. I've had a great deal of practice.
Look at you, tidy as a clock. Someone taught you well.
Done already? I was just getting comfortable. Fine. Up you go.
And that's the day. Don't look so stricken, Keeper. There's always another.
Out of hours already. Honestly, Keeper, you're so slow at letting go.
Time wins again. It always does. Shall we try the day once more?
Oh, that? Just an old hour. Don't mind it, Keeper.
Ignore it, Keeper. Old hours get clingy. Don't stare.
Poof! Tidy again. You do love a clean slate, Keeper.
Gone, just like that. Isn't it nice when things stay burned?
Gently, Keeper. Everything burns faster than it looks.
Heavy, that one. Don't expect me to enjoy the lifting.
Another one for the pile. Ha. You never get tired of this.
Every time you burn, something wakes. Keep going. I'm curious how long.
Carried. Again. Funny how the laugh won't come when I want it.
Hour to hour, ash to ash. I carry it all, Keeper. Every time.
Undo it. Pretend. The hours remember even if you don't.
Ha! Rewinding. As if the shadows wait politely for you.
Undo what you like. The shadows still remember it, Keeper.
Still here. Still waiting. We're good at that, you and I.
Think faster, Keeper. The sun never waits. Not for you, not for me.
Quiet now. Hear them? That's every hour you've spent, standing very still.
Solved. Congratulations. Look behind you, if you dare.
Another hour kept. Another one left behind. You're so tidy, Keeper.
Out of hours, Keeper. Ha. They do run out, you know.
Again from the start. I can't say I mind. I've had practice.
That's another hour burned out. Keep this up and they'll all be shadows.
Gone, you think? Ha. Wave goodbye, Keeper. They don't forget faces.
There. Satisfied? That was somebody's whole afternoon, you know.
More of them. Don't look at me, Keeper. You lit every one.
Burn it, Keeper. You've never needed my permission. Just my hands.
That one I enjoyed. Almost like old times. Almost like being warm.
Delivered. Everything I carry goes out, one way or another.
Hear the echo? It's coming back, Keeper. Longer every time.
Undo all you like, Keeper. I've waited longer than you've been winding.
Go on, rewind. The ending waits for you either way.
Think carefully, Keeper. You're deciding for two of us.
Take your time. I'm very, very good at waiting. I've had ages.
One hour closer to the center. Hear the gears, Keeper? That's me.
Well climbed, Keeper. Nearly at the heart of it. Nearly at me.
The dial ran dry, Keeper. I could have told you it would.
Out of hours. Don't worry, Keeper. I'll keep the fire going. I always do.
They know you now, Keeper. Every last one. Say hello.
Clear them away, Keeper. It won't make the clock any less dead.
Surprised? Your Keepers were so proud of how well I burned.
Duty, or me. I won't make it easy, Keeper. I never could.
Wind it tight, Keeper. Make sure it holds. It always held me.
There it goes. Listen, Keeper. That's what warm sounds like.
Boo! Don't flinch, Keeper. It's only yesterday, come to say hello.
Shoo. There. Gone. See, Keeper? Hours don't linger if you ask nicely.
Another hour feeds the fire, Keeper. How warm it must feel, from out there.
There. Carried. Soon there'll be nothing left to carry, Keeper.
Again? Keeper, you rewind like someone afraid of the end.
Listen to the ticking, Keeper. That's the sound of me, holding.
Closer. Can you feel it? The whole tower leans toward me.
Dial's done. Pity. I was so looking forward to the end.
Look how many there are. That's every day you've ever kept.
They're not angry, Keeper. They're just very, very tired of being kept.
One less. Don't mistake it for mercy, Keeper. It's only quieter.
Burn them out if you like. Somebody still has to remember them.
Another hour in my hands, Keeper. Careful. I never learned to put things down.
Ash goes where I carry it, Keeper. Everything does, in the end.
Neat work, Keeper. Every hour you keep is one more I burn.
Rewind again, Keeper. The hours remember. So do I.
Still thinking, Keeper? The wick doesn't wait. Only I do.
The last hour, Keeper. You kept it beautifully. Then it was mine.
Quiet now. They'll be back, Keeper. Ash always finds its hour.
There they are, Keeper. Every hour you spent, standing up.
Don't look away. They're only the days you kept, Keeper.
Hold still, Keeper. The last hour is always the warmest.
Watch it fall, Keeper. This is how every hour wanted to end.
